title: Ondo media placeholder
description: A plain token-coloured surface standing in for a photo, video or chart until a real one is passed in: muted grey, a mid-grey 'photo' tone, or a faint wash for charts. It fills whatever box it is given.
notes: size and radius come from the parent or className
name: ondo-placeholder

props.name: tone
props.description: muted: the panel grey · deep: one step darker (nested frames) · photo: a mid-grey for full photos · faint: a light wash for charts

props.name: label
props.description: what the slot will hold, read to screen readers (e.g. "Photo of a skyline")
